description: Move a report to a new workflow state, enforcing the same transition rules as the admin UI. Valid targets: classified, grouped, fixing, fixed, verified, reopened, dismissed. Returns { report } with the updated status. Write; idempotent (setting the current status is a no-op); rejects illegal transitions. Use to dismiss a duplicate or mark fixed; use merge_fix to mark fixed via a merged PR, or reopen_report for the reopened path.

status.description: Target status (resolved is stored as fixed)

name: transition_status
title: Move report between states
